# Pull request

## Summary

What does this PR change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Docs / chore / refactor

## Related issues

Closes # (issue number, if applicable).

## How to test

Steps or commands for reviewers (e.g. `pytest`, `npm run build`).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (or explain why not needed)
- [ ] Docs updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets committed (API keys, tokens, `.env` contents)
- [ ] Database migrations included if the schema changed
- [ ] Linked issue(s) referenced above
